use default
use Raster.Anchor
use Raster.COLOUR_MAP
use Raster.IMAGE
use Raster.SHAPES
use System.Math.min

let source = "rosettacode"
let target = "raisethysword"

let cell = 38
let left = 46
let top = 58

distances(source: string, target: string) -> LIST[LIST[int]] is
    let rows = LIST[LIST[int]]()
    let first = LIST[int]()

    for j in 0::target.length do
        first.add(j)
    od

    rows.add(first)

    for i in 1::source.length do
        let previous = rows[i - 1]
        let current = LIST([i])

        for j in 1::target.length do
            let same = source[i - 1] == target[j - 1]
            let substitution = previous[j - 1] + if same then 0 else 1 fi

            current.add(
                min(substitution,
                    min(previous[j] + 1, current[j - 1] + 1)))
        od

        rows.add(current)
    od

    rows
si

let table = distances(source, target)

alignment() -> LIST[(row: int, column: int)] is
    let i mut = source.length
    let j mut = target.length

    let path = LIST([(row = i, column = j)])

    while i > 0 \/ j > 0 do
        let same = i > 0 /\ j > 0 /\ source[i - 1] == target[j - 1]
        let step = if same then 0 else 1 fi

        if i > 0 /\ j > 0 /\ table[i][j] == table[i - 1][j - 1] + step then
            i = i - 1
            j = j - 1
        elif i > 0 /\ table[i][j] == table[i - 1][j] + 1 then
            i = i - 1
        else
            j = j - 1
        fi

        path.add((row = i, column = j))
    od

    path
si

corner(row: int, column: int) -> (x: double, y: double) =>
    (x = cast double(left + column * cell),
     y = cast double(top + row * cell))

centre(row: int, column: int) -> (x: double, y: double) =>
    (x = cast double(left + column * cell) + 0.5 * cast double(cell),
     y = cast double(top + row * cell) + 0.5 * cast double(cell))

let highest = cast double(source.length + target.length) / 2.0

let image = IMAGE(
    left + (target.length + 1) * cell + 14,
    top + (source.length + 1) * cell + 14)

let cells = SHAPES()

for row in 0::source.length do
    for column in 0::target.length do
        let at = corner(row, column)
        let to = corner(row + 1, column + 1)

        cells.add(
            [(x = at.x, y = at.y),
             (x = to.x, y = at.y),
             (x = to.x, y = to.y),
             (x = at.x, y = to.y)],
            COLOUR_MAP.viridis(cast double(table[row][column]) / highest))
    od
od

image.fill(cells)

image.colour(225ub, 60ub, 60ub)
image.stroke(2.4)
image.line(
    alignment()
        |> map(step => centre(step.row, step.column))
        |> collect_list())

for row in 0::source.length do
    for column in 0::target.length do
        let shade = cast double(table[row][column]) / highest

        if shade < 0.55 then
            image.colour(250ub, 250ub, 250ub)
        else
            image.colour(35ub, 40ub, 35ub)
        fi

        let middle = centre(row, column)

        image.text(
            middle.x, middle.y + 5.0, 15.0,
            "{table[row][column]}", Anchor.CENTRE)
    od
od

image.colour(70ub, 75ub, 90ub)

for column in 1::target.length do
    let middle = centre(0, column)

    image.text(
        middle.x, cast double(top) - 9.0, 17.0,
        "{target[column - 1]}", Anchor.CENTRE)
od

for row in 1::source.length do
    let middle = centre(row, 0)

    image.text(
        cast double(left) - 9.0, middle.y + 5.0, 17.0,
        "{source[row - 1]}", Anchor.RIGHT)
od

image.text(
    cast double(left), 26.0, 14.0,
    "{source} to {target} in {table[source.length][target.length]} edits")

image.write("levenshtein.png")

image.show("levenshtein.png")
